SWIFTLET
  • SWIFTLET: SWIFT Lightcone Extension Tools
  • View page source

SWIFTLET: SWIFT Lightcone Extension Tools

SWIFTLET builds custom lightcones from SWIFT simulation outputs (FLAMINGO, COLIBRE), from particle data or halo catalogues, serially or with MPI, and provides tools to analyse and visualise them.

Installation

Install SWIFTLET with pip and configure your environment.
